statement: In held-out mixed markets the reliability-condition agent earns more than each rival.
quantity: PR1 verdict of the registered tournament protocol

statement: The reliability-condition agent's advantage grows with environmental uncertainty.
The reliability-condition agent adapts less often than the always-adjust rule.
The reliability-condition agent's selectivity is what earns its advantage.
The reliability-condition agent is robust across market protocols.
The reliability-condition agent carries less downside risk than always adjusting.
The confidence-sensitive gate's advantage over the better fixed rule falls as the learnability ratio R rises.
quantity: OLS slope of configuration-mean advantage on log10 R, 95% bootstrap CI below 0
effect_units: net payoff per period per decade of R

statement: log10 R explains the gate's advantage beyond outcome volatility and observation noise.
quantity: gain in leave-one-out cross-validated R-squared from adding log10 R

statement: The learnability index adds predictive accuracy beyond the prespecified comparison model, on held-out configurations.
quantity: difference in cross-validated R-squared, bootstrap lower limit above 0

statement: The index transfers to held-out process families.
quantity: difference in cross-validated R-squared on unseen families

statement: The confidence-sensitive gate's reported lower bound has its nominal 90% coverage.
quantity: measured coverage of the 90% bound across feedback regimes
note: Rejected on the first run at 45-62%. The replication asks whether that was sampling.

statement: On the control process, the correctly specified model wins.
quantity: rank of bayes_true by mean regret on the `base` family

statement: Where distributional shape is the problem, shape-free window models win.
quantity: rank of saa by mean regret on the `multimodal` family

statement: The moment-ambiguity model, the only one able to price outcomes never observed, is the one suited to the outside-support family.
quantity: rank of dro_moment by mean regret on the `outside_support` family
note: Contradicted on the first run: it finished behind both models that provably cannot represent the stress.

statement: Knowing the true nuisance parameters beats having the right functional form.
quantity: number of the five stress families on which bayes_true ranks first

statement: Bought information and recorded unmet demand are substitutes.
quantity: value of information at unmet_access 0.0 minus at 1.0

statement: Buying information pays only when the environment changes fast enough.
quantity: net of buying at the lowest hazard
note: Supported in the sense that the prediction was of a NEGATIVE net at low hazard.
